collection.method: One forward bounded byte-snapshot traversal of each of four already-existing files; all aggregates computed in memory; no production inputs, service changes, network requests, or stress tests. Window is [start, end); the observed maximum is strictly before end, with no record at the exact end boundary.

coverage.missingWindowPrefixExplanation: No retained file earlier than observedFirst; size-based rotation (10MiB x current plus 3 backups) cannot prove complete rolling 72-hour retention.
coverage.silenceMeaning: Intervals without timestamped log records are observability gaps, not proof of service outage or healthy operation.

limitations: No overall event-loop percentiles are calculated: only threshold alerts are logged (>20ms, cooldown for noncritical); maxLag may represent multiple alert samples.

Host structured input rows exclude high-frequency moves/wheels in favor of cumulative count-only aggregate emissions; aggregate count fields cannot be summed as independent inputs. Results may lack IDs and cannot be treated as unique user gestures or input success rate.

Keyboard wire hostExecuteMs and frame_timing are invalid for precise causal/visual timing; this audit uses localExecuteMs adapter-await only. Adapter-await includes internal queue/executor scheduling, not only Quartz execution.
Input timing and lock-contention logs are conditional/censored and describe logged samples, not a distribution of all inputs. Incoming valid input count includes receipt, not successful execution.

CAPTURE_STATS reports recv/output windows. convert is AV frame construction; recv_total includes pacing/queue/build, excludes encoding/RTP. grab timing and captured-frame age are absent from ordinary samples. Reuse means no new selected capture, not proof of unchanged screen content.

Encoder sample means are weighted by each window encode.count; max is a reported frame wall-time maximum, not CPU time. Per-window p95 is not globally aggregated. Codec groups are different sessions/load/resolution/targetFps conditions, not a matched A/B comparison.

Relay avg_encode_ms encloses synchronous capture+array/PIL/JPEG work, not just compression. avg_ack_ms may use client cross-clock latency and is not validated network RTT. Relay sent/acked windows may straddle in-flight boundaries.
Metrics are marginal per-stage windows, not paired frame/input observations; they cannot be summed into end-to-end latency. Stage overlap and concurrent capture prohibit simple addition.
Embedded Viewer replay logs are excluded from Host events/metrics. Raw input content, keyboard codes/text, mouse coordinates, socket/viewer/lease/input IDs, URLs, and credentials are not copied.

Current source definitions establish measurement meaning but loaded-code identity for every historical process is not independently verified. Files were still being appended; byte snapshots plus hashes define exact inspected prefix.

recv_total starts before the suspended/resume wait in host.py:1257-1276. Large output-window recv_total can include intentional suspension and cannot by itself prove active capture/encoding took that long. Media-active state must be joined before interpreting outliers.

Connection closed logs include expected teardown/reconnect; counts are state transitions, not unique unexpected failures. Error categories are recognized templates, not an exhaustive classification of every ERROR/traceback line.

computedObservations.finding: Retained Host logs do not cover the requested full 72h
A real input queue burst exceeded one minute
Reliable mouse up and reset waited roughly 32 seconds inside Host adapter
Event-loop stalls persist in some snapshots without active peer or relay
computedObservations.notProof: No claim that these alone identify global resource cause; correlated system pressure evidence is separate.
